title: Importance Sampling Enhanced with the COS Method for the Portfolio Risk Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30749v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce ISCOS, a cross-entropy importance-sampling calibration method for rare credit-portfolio losses. We derive Gaussian and Gaussian--inverse-Gamma proposals and analyse the propagation of finite-COS approximation errors to the fitted parameters. Numerical experiments for Gaussian and Student t-copula credit portfolios show the efficiency of this method.

translated_title: 基于COS方法增强的重要性抽样在投资组合风险分配中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ISCOS，一种针对稀有信用投资组合损失的交叉熵重要性抽样校准方法。我们推导了高斯分布和高斯-逆伽马分布的建议分布，并分析了有限COS近似误差向拟合参数的传播过程。针对高斯Copula和Student t-Copula信用投资组合的数值实验证明了该方法的高效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合COS方法的交叉熵重要性抽样校准方法ISCOS，通过推导高斯及高斯-逆伽马建议分布并分析近似误差传播，实现了对稀有信用投资组合损失的高效估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ISCOS, a cross-entropy importance-sampling calibration method enhanced with the COS method, which efficiently estimates rare credit-portfolio losses by deriving Gaussian and Gaussian-inverse-Gamma proposals and analyzing the propagation of finite-COS approximation errors.
